snippet.title: Dig Dug on the PC-6001
snippet.description: Controls feel slightly delayed on this port, maybe it's the emulator I am using? Emulated using PC-6001VW ver310d. One thing about this port is that you can't get extra lives, you only have the 3 lives you get at the start. Another unique thing in this port is that there's intermissions, or coffee breaks, after every 4 levels.
